value.name: discuss estate records and codicil
value.description: The speakers discuss the deceased lawyer's stroke, the absorption of his practice, and whether any codicil or estate papers exist at the bank.
evidence: He had a stroke. His practice was absorbed by, what, Hennessey and someone. If there was a codicil, they would have it. They sent everything to the bank.
"They sent what they had," Asha said.
"What they had is what there was."

value.name: Daniel asserts mother promised him the house
value.description: Daniel insists that his mother told him the house was his and says he has no reason to invent the claim.
evidence: "My mother," he said, "told me a year ago that the house was mine. She told me at Christmas. She told me when we were sitting in that parlor right there. She said, 'Daniel, you've worked for this, you've been the one I could count on, the house is yours and you'll do what you need to do with it.' I am not making this up. I have no reason to make this up."

value.name: Asha distinguishes witness claim from fabrication
value.description: Asha reassures Daniel that no one accused him of lying and reframes Rosa's statement as a claim about witnessing a document.
evidence: "No one said you were making it up," Asha said.
"Rosa is saying she witnessed a document. Those are different statements."

value.name: Lucia asks about mother's meaning
value.description: Lucia breaks her silence and asks what her mother meant by 'the person who stays.'
evidence: Lucia spoke for the first time in a while. "What did Mom mean by the person who stays."

value.name: Rosa refuses to explain directly
value.description: Rosa tells Lucia she thinks Lucia already knows what their mother meant and declines to spell it out.
evidence: Rosa looked at her. "I think you know what she meant."

value.name: Rosa joins the family at the table
value.description: Rosa sits down at the table, shifting her status from staff to an equal participant in the family confrontation.
evidence: Rosa pulled out a chair and sat down, finally, and the gesture changed the room. She was no longer staff. She was a fourth person at the table.

value.name: Rosa reveals mother's declining health
value.description: Rosa explains that their mother had been sick for a long time before anyone acknowledged it and could not be left alone at night.
evidence: "Your mother was sick for a long time before anyone admitted she was sick," Rosa said.
"In the last year she could not be alone in the house at night."

value.name: Daniel stays with mother for months
value.description: Rosa says Daniel returned home for two weeks in May but remained for seven months, sleeping in the sewing room and driving his mother to appointments.
evidence: You came home for two weeks in May and you stayed seven months.
You slept in the sewing room.
You drove her to her appointments.
